title: Roman domination on subclasses of bipartite graphs
summary: The Roman Domination Problem (RDP) on a simple, finite, undirected graph \(G=(V,E)\) asks for a labeling function \(f:V\rightarrow\{0,1,2\}\) such that every vertex assigned value \(0\) is adjacent to at least one vertex assigned value \(2\). The objective is to minimize the total weight \(\sum_{v\in V} f(v)\), and this minimum value is called the Roman domination number of \(G\), denoted by \(γ_R(G)\).
